maria p: Quick async qtr OKR check — sharing a short snapshot of what shipped, what slipped, and open asks. Please update by EOD so I can roll into Friday's weekly.

Shipped:
• runtime autoscale v2 (canary)
• infra per-route metrics dashboard (alpha)

Slipped:
• Dedicated Private (VPC) rollout for Customer X — blocked by network certs
• model quantization POC (rescoping to next quarter)

Open asks:
• @taylor (eng-lead) confirm canary health & ramp plan
• @alex c owner for kv-cache followups + CR status
• @priya r to confirm customer X unblock ETA from security/infra
• Add short status + owner in the OKR tracker (link pinned in #product)

TL;DR: update tracker + ping owners. I'll collate.


taylor (eng-lead): Canary at 20% traffic, steady. Latency +5ms p50, no error spikes. CPU +8% on p4s. Suggest ramp to 50% after perf test window tomorrow morning. <https://git.company/pr/3421|PR #3421> in review — needs perf signoff from @sam l.

alex c: Merged KV-cache change to canary. Observability added. CRs: one minor doc change requested. I'll do sam's perf notes after he finishes review. Dedicated VPC blocked by infra ticket #987 (routing + certs). @maria p any word from infra on ETA?

priya r: Customer X update: security needs cert approvals + compliance checklist to sign off; security estimated Tue next week. Moving model quant POC to backlog for next qtr — reassigning owner to research to keep momentum. Updated the OKR tracker and left comments on the rollout row. :eyes: 

sam l: Perf signoff on PR #3421 for 20% canary. Request adding latency histogram to dashboard before 50% ramp. Will review kv-cache CR today and reply inline.

deploy-bot: deploy started: autoscale-v2-canary -> 20% (ts: 1798882387)

infra team: Working ticket #987 — routing rule needs a cert from security. We can do a manual bypass for internal tests if security gives a greenlight, otherwise ETA Tue as priya mentioned.

maria p: Thanks — action items:
• @taylor ramp plan + perf window confirmation (tomorrow AM)
• @sam add histogram + finish CRs (EOD)
• @alex follow infra ticket and note manual test plan if available
• @priya coordinate with security and update tracker with final ETA

If anyone else has changes, drop a one-liner here. I'll compile and send the weekly update by 5pm PST. :thumbsup:
